## Checklist

- [ ] Internal links resolve
- [ ] Requirement IDs are unchanged, or new ones use the next unused number in their group —
      never a gap left by a retired requirement
- [ ] Retired requirements are marked `Retired`, not deleted
- [ ] A significant or hard-to-reverse decision is recorded as an ADR (NFR-MAINT-4) and added
      to the [ADR index](../adr/README.md)
- [ ] Domain terms give the Norwegian term in parentheses on first use, and the
      [glossary](../glossary.md) covers them
- [ ] No hand-edits to generated files (`requirements/traceability.md`)
